headline: Vardhman Special Steels submits demat report for September 2026
summary: Vardhman Special Steels Limited has submitted its monthly demat report to the stock exchanges for September 2026. This is a routine compliance filing detailing the depository participant data for the company. Such procedural disclosures do not impact the company's financial performance or stock valuation. Indian retail investors have no actionable takeaways from this routine regulatory update.
why_it_matters: No financial impact or action required for retail holders

headline: Vardhman Special Steels allots 77,250 securities under ESOP
summary: Vardhman Special Steels Limited has announced the allotment of 77,250 securities pursuant to its employee stock option or purchase schemes following a board meeting on October 5, 2026. This routine corporate action increases the company's total paid-up equity base slightly. For an Indian retail investor, such ESOP allotments cause marginal equity dilution but are standard for employee compensation.
why_it_matters: Slight equity dilution from routine employee stock option allotment.
